ICAR IARI Junior Research Fellow Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Junior Research Fellow position at ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Research Fellow position at ICAR IARI is scheduled for 17 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or M.Tech degree in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Plant Biochemistry, Life Sciences, Food Science, or a relevant discipline from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. Is NET/GATE qualification mandatory for this Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: No, NET/GATE qualification is not mandatory for this Junior Research Fellow position at ICAR IARI.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any age relaxations for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of 3 years for OBC candidates and 5 years for SC/ST/Women candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Junior Research Fellow to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110012.
